description: This file defines a React component for uploading files in a Next.js frontend. It includes UI components for drag-and-drop, file previews, category labels, and simulates connecting to LinkedIn. The main component, IngestionClient, manages local state for uploaded files and provides an interface for users to upload documents for persona building.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string with units like B, KB, MB, GB.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension in uppercase or 'FILE' if extension is missing or extension equals filename in uppercase.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Converts upload category to its display label.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Provides the title for each upload category to display in UI.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Determines the accent color associated with each upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Specifies accepted file types for upload inputs.
